question: Does a fixed source-only capture-time/exposure ridge show enough development signal on consumed P240 rows to justify opening any fresh metadata confirmation target?

information_flow.target: log red/green and blue/green ratios from green-normalized AsShotNeutral

cyclic_target.target_rule: Within each leave-one-out training fold sorted by repository ID, rotate target rows left by one.

global_mean.rule: Within each leave-one-out fold, predict the mean two-channel log target.

evaluation.split: exact leave-one-row-out over the 17 consumed P240 complete rows
evaluation.metric: angular error in degrees between predicted and target green-normalized neutral vectors

stop_rule: If the full model fails any development gate, close this exact feature/ridge family before reading any fresh P241 EXIF or AsShotNeutral target. Do not tune features, alpha, gates or cyclic control on P240. A pass would only permit a separately frozen file/model-isolated metadata confirmation.
claim_ceiling: Consumed-development metadata-only source-observation discriminant. No fresh confirmation, natural-image AWB quality, candidate-3, RAW operator, package, schema, capability, film-stock or product claim.
